_comment: One entry per prose sentence of paper.md, recording what supports it. See scripts/check_paper_claims.py for the source kinds. A commit may not add an unverified sentence.

claims.sentence: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) records the height topography of individual nanofibers [@Mayumi2026].

sources.quote: The TEM-derived widths and AFM-derived heights of the CNCs and CNFs averaged approximately 10 nm
AFM images revealed that the representative cross-sectional geometry of the CNFs exhibits widths and thicknesses of 15.0 and 9.3 nm

claims.note: Adopted by the user on 2026-10-22 after fact-check rounds 1-6.
claims.ja: 原子間力顕微鏡（AFM）は、個々のナノファイバーの高さ形状を記録する [@Mayumi2026]。

claims.sentence: `AFM Nanofiber Analyzer` is a Python toolkit that turns such height scans into per-fiber measurements.
claims.note: Adopted by the user on 2026-10-22 after fact-check rounds 1-6.
claims.ja: `AFM Nanofiber Analyzer` は、そうした高さ像を繊維ごとの測定値に変える Python ツールキットである。

claims.sentence: It reads AFM height images exported as text/CSV or stored in native Gwyddion `.gwy` files, removes instrument background, segments and skeletonizes the fibers, detects sharp bends ("kinks"), and reports per-fiber statistics such as length, height, and kink geometry (\autoref{fig:pipeline}).
claims.ja: テキスト/CSV で書き出された、または Gwyddion 形式の `.gwy` ファイルに保存された AFM 高さ像を読み込み、装置由来の背景を除去し、繊維を領域分割・細線化し、急な曲がり（「キンク」）を検出して、長さ・高さ・キンクの形状などの繊維ごとの統計量を出力する（\autoref{fig:pipeline}）。

claims.sentence: The same analysis is exposed through a tkinter launcher with five interactive tools and a command-line interface for batch processing, both built on one shared analysis library.
claims.note: Five tracked plugins: git ls-files guis lists GUI00-GUI04.
claims.ja: 同じ解析は、5 つの対話型ツールを備えた tkinter のランチャーと一括処理用のコマンドラインインターフェースの両方から使え、両者は一つの共通の解析ライブラリの上に構築されている。

claims.sentence: Results are written as one compressed bundle per input (`.b2z`) whose keys, shapes, units, and coordinate convention are governed by an executable schema validated when the bundle is written and before it is measured.
claims.ja: 結果は入力 1 件につき 1 つの圧縮バンドル（`.b2z`）に書き出され、そのキー・配列形状・単位・座標の取り方は、バンドルの書き込み時と測定前に検証される実行可能なスキーマで規定されている。

claims.sentence: Studies of nanocellulose compare preparations by the heights of fibers measured on AFM images [e.g., @Ito2025; @Mayumi2026].

sources.quote: The modes of the height distributions for BKP-10, BKP-5, HC-10, and HC-5 were 1.95, 2.05, 1.95, and 2.15 nm, respectively.
The TEM-derived widths and AFM-derived heights of the CNCs and CNFs averaged approximately 10 nm
increased in number after ultrasonication of the CNFs

claims.note: Fact-checked in four independent rounds on 2026-10-21; approved by the user.
claims.ja: ナノセルロースの研究では、AFM 像上で測った繊維の高さによって、調製法の異なる試料を比較する [e.g., @Ito2025; @Mayumi2026]。

claims.sentence: Defects along the fibers matter as well: preparations differ in how many and how large defects their fibers carry [@Ito2025], and deep dents on the fiber surface induce kinking and fragmentation [@Ito2022].

sources.quote: Compared with the BKP series, the HC series had fewer and smaller defects under the same pH conditions.
deep dents induced the kinking and fragmentation of nanofibers

claims.note: Fact-checked in four independent rounds on 2026-10-21; approved by the user.
claims.ja: 繊維に沿った欠陥も重要である。調製法の異なる試料の間で、繊維が持つ欠陥の数と大きさは異なり [@Ito2025]、繊維表面の深いへこみはキンクと断片化を引き起こす [@Ito2022]。

claims.sentence: It is built as a documented pipeline on the scientific Python stack — NumPy [@Harris2020], SciPy [@Virtanen2020], scikit-image [@vanderWalt2014], OpenCV [@Bradski2000], lmfit [@Newville2014], and Matplotlib [@Hunter2007].

claims.sentence: It gives researchers a scriptable batch interface and a bundle format whose layout is versioned, documented, and validated when a bundle is written and before it is measured.

claims.ja: 本ツールは研究者に、スクリプトから使える一括処理のインターフェースと、レイアウトが版管理・文書化され、バンドルの書き込み時と測定前に検証されるバンドル形式を提供する。

claims.sentence: Gwyddion [@Necas2012] is a modular, open-source package for scanning probe microscopy data processing, with functions for levelling and background subtraction, grain and particle analysis, and other image-level operations.

sources.quote: a modular, multiplatform, open-source software for scanning probe microscopy data processing

sources.locator: user guide, Leveling and Background Subtraction

Projected boundary length, the length of the grain boundary projected to the horizontal plane

claims.sentence: FiberApp reads Bruker NanoScope and `.flt` files, taking the scan size from their headers, and TIFF images, for which it assumes one nanometre per pixel until the user draws a scale bar and enters its length; this project reads instrument text and CSV exports, Gwyddion Export Text, and native `.gwy` files, takes the physical scan size from the file where the export records it or from a value the user enters, and records it in the bundle.

claims.sentence: The scientific-Python ecosystem supplies the lower-level building blocks [@Harris2020; @vanderWalt2014; @Virtanen2020; @Bradski2000]; this project assembles them into a fiber-centric pipeline with shared GUI and CLI front ends, a recorded parameter file per run, and an explicit, versioned data contract, so the same analysis can be scripted, audited, and rerun with the settings it recorded.
claims.note: Adopted by the user on 2026-10-22 after fact-check rounds 1-6.

claims.sentence: Shared preprocessing and analysis workflow from AFM height input to downstream GUI analyses and a compressed bundle.

sources.observed: Inputs (.txt from Shimadzu, Bruker or Gwyddion, or .gwy) -> GUI01 (Calibrated, Binarized, Skeletonized + Kink-detected) -> .b2z bundle -> GUI02 Plot Profiler, GUI03 Fiber Morphology Statistics, GUI04 Fiber Tracker.

claims.ja: AFM 高さの入力から、下流の GUI による解析と圧縮バンドルまでの、共通の前処理・解析の流れ。

claims.sentence: The toolkit is organized so that both front ends share one implementation of the analysis.
claims.ja: 本ツールキットは、両方のフロントエンドが解析の一つの実装を共有するように構成されている。

claims.sentence: As summarized in \autoref{fig:pipeline}, AFM height data from Shimadzu, Bruker or Gwyddion text exports, or native Gwyddion `.gwy` files, enters the *Image Preprocessor* (GUI01), which produces calibrated, binarized, and skeletonized/kink-detected images and writes them to one `.b2z` bundle per input.
claims.ja: \autoref{fig:pipeline} にまとめたように、島津・Bruker・Gwyddion のテキスト出力、または Gwyddion 形式の `.gwy` ファイルの AFM 高さデータは *Image Preprocessor*（GUI01）に入り、補正・二値化・細線化／キンク検出の各画像が作られ、入力 1 件につき 1 つの `.b2z` バンドルに書き出される。

claims.sentence: The resulting bundles are consumed by the *Plot Profiler* (GUI02), the *Fiber Morphology Statistics* (GUI03), and the *Fiber Tracker* (GUI04) for line-profile extraction, grouped morphology statistics, and per-fiber tracking and measurement, respectively.
claims.ja: 作られたバンドルは、*Plot Profiler*（GUI02）、*Fiber Morphology Statistics*（GUI03）、*Fiber Tracker*（GUI04）がそれぞれ、線プロファイルの抽出、グループ別の形態統計、繊維ごとの追跡と測定に使う。

claims.sentence: A tkinter launcher discovers these tools in `guis/`, together with the *Format Converter* (GUI00), which converts files GUI01 cannot read into `.gwy` by running the separately installed, optional `gwyconvert` converter.
claims.ja: tkinter のランチャーは、これらのツールを *Format Converter*（GUI00）とともに `guis/` から見つけ出す。*Format Converter* は、別途インストールする任意の変換ツール `gwyconvert` を実行して、GUI01 が読めないファイルを `.gwy` に変換する。

claims.sentence: Modules in `lib/` implement the input handling, background calibration, segmentation, skeletonization, kink detection, and per-fiber measurement.
claims.ja: `lib/` のモジュールが、入力の処理、背景補正、領域分割、細線化、キンク検出、繊維ごとの測定を実装している。

claims.sentence: A command-line interface provides batch preprocessing, validation, measurement, skeleton-height extraction, and bundle export.
claims.ja: コマンドラインインターフェースは、一括の前処理、検証、測定、スケルトン上の高さの抽出、バンドルの書き出しを提供する。

claims.sentence: The GUI preprocessor and the CLI call the same pipeline function, and the GUI measurement views and the CLI call the same measurement routines, so equivalent runs produce identical numerical results — keeping the analysis in `lib/` and the interfaces thin is a deliberate choice that prevents the front ends from drifting apart.
claims.note: The bundle equivalence test runs on a synthetic scan.
claims.ja: GUI の前処理と CLI は同じパイプライン関数を呼び、GUI の測定画面と CLI は同じ測定ルーチンを呼ぶので、同等の実行は同一の数値結果を生む。解析を `lib/` に置きインターフェースを薄く保つのは、フロントエンド同士が食い違っていくのを防ぐための意図的な選択である。

claims.sentence: Results are persisted as one compressed bundle per input (`.b2z`, built on `blosc2`) with a JSON record of the analysis parameters.
claims.ja: 結果は入力 1 件につき 1 つの圧縮バンドル（`.b2z`、`blosc2` を基盤とする）として、解析パラメータの JSON 記録とともに保存される。

claims.sentence: The bundle's required keys, shapes, units, coordinate convention, and format version are defined by an executable schema validated both when the bundle is written and before it is measured, so the measurement tools fail loudly on an out-of-contract bundle instead of producing silently wrong measurements.
